confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Algarve coastal resort pricing for July peak season; no live listings were checked. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and property. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.75x beer, wine glass about 1.4x beer), since direct knowledge is weaker there. FX: the 0.6955 figure was taken from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page. I could not open that RBA page directly, and a follow-up search did not corroborate the 15 October figure, so it should be confirmed against the RBA F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Algarve coastal resort towns of similar size and tourist profile (for example Portimao and Albufeira), with summer peak-season uplift applied to accommodation and drinks.
